# SurvivorSymmetry — survivors are mirror-symmetric

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** proved in Lean · **Diagram:** [How survivors spread across the cycle](../../GRAPH.md#how-survivors-spread-across-the-cycle)

A position survives the wheels exactly when its reflection in the combined cycle survives. Counting form (Legendre's mirror for phi(x, a)): the survivors up to a point and up to its mirror point together number one full cycle's survivors.

## Published sources

Published work this node rests on or relates to; each entry says how.

- [Legendre's formula (MathWorld), the identity phi(t, k) = phi(m_k) - phi(m_k - t - 1, k)](https://mathworld.wolfram.com/LegendresFormula.html) — the counting form, as Legendre's mirror identity for phi(x, a)
- [D. H. Lehmer, The distribution of totatives, Canad. J. Math. 7 (1955), 347-357](https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/aop-cambridge-core/content/view/A1B6054448396406512E4ECE51DC6ADD/S0008414X00030467a.pdf/distribution_of_totatives.pdf) — Theorem 1
- [G. F. Grob and M. Schmitt, Cycles and Patterns in the Sieve of Eratosthenes, arXiv:1905.03117, Theorem 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.03117) — restates it

## Claims

<a id="survivor_reflection"></a>
### `survivor_reflection`

A position at or below the cycle length survives exactly when the cycle length minus the position survives.

```lean
/-- **Mirror symmetry.** For any wheels `W` and a position `k` at or below
the cycle length, `k` survives every wheel exactly when the cycle length
minus `k` does. (No primality is needed.) -/
def survivor_reflection : Prop :=
  ∀ (W : Finset Nat) (k : Nat), k ≤ W.prod id →
    ((∀ q ∈ W, ¬ q ∣ k) ↔ (∀ q ∈ W, ¬ q ∣ W.prod id - k))
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `RNS.SurvivorSymmetry.survivor_reflection_holds` in [`RNSSolutions/SurvivorSymmetry.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/SurvivorSymmetry.lean)

<a id="survivor_count_reflection"></a>
### `survivor_count_reflection`

For nonempty wheels and a point t before the end of the cycle, the survivors up to t and up to the cycle length minus t minus 1 together number one full cycle's survivors.

```lean
/-- **Mirror symmetry, counting form.** For a nonempty set of wheels `W` and a
point `t` before the end of the cycle, the survivors up to `t` and the
survivors up to the cycle length minus `t` minus 1 together number one full
cycle's survivors. -/
def survivor_count_reflection : Prop :=
  ∀ (W : Finset Nat) (t : Nat), W.Nonempty → t < W.prod id →
    (survivors_upto W t).card + (survivors_upto W (W.prod id - t - 1)).card
      = (survivors_upto W (W.prod id)).card
```

**Rests on:** [`SurvivorSymmetry.survivor_reflection`](SurvivorSymmetry.md#survivor_reflection)

**Proof:** `RNS.SurvivorSymmetry.survivor_count_reflection_step` in [`RNSSolutions/SurvivorSymmetry.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/SurvivorSymmetry.lean); joined to its inputs in [`RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean)
